observations.why: Imperative directive enacting command over the recipient's epistemic state — a hierarchical move telling the audience what to discard from memory.
Second imperative command reinforcing the same hierarchical stance — speaker directs the recipient's cognitive operations by authority, not by request or negotiation.

mints.name: DirectiveMemoryPurge
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.frame: Is the speaker claiming authority to command what the recipient must purge from memory, rather than requesting or negotiating it?
